diagnosis: All eleven joins failed. Modes 0, 2 and 5 lack the required original caller exit generation: the successful 35-second wait is followed directly by cleanup, without the fresh PID/time/wait/exit-code API cohort. The other modes retain all four generations but the validator indexes raw core bytes as a decoded dictionary. These source defects remain failures; native logs and exit requirements are not relaxed.
limitations: Historical failure on its exact source head; no missing exit observation or failed join is relabeled as success.
Retained per-case original copy hashes and zero copy debt do not establish independent storage durability or host cleanup.
Outer/observer completion does not establish complete caller/outer/observer acceptance.
Public synthetic debugger preparation cannot accept any game resolution or replace missing production verifiers.
